extracted.intended_audience: prospective and current students, faculty, staff, alumni, and stakeholders (e.g., donors)
extracted.subtask_description: An informational about-page for the Donald P. Bellisario College of Communications describing the college's programs, accreditation, values, community commitments, diversity/equity goals, and sustainability priorities. Designed to communicate institutional standards and commitments to internal and external audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: ACEJMC Accreditation — commitment to national standards
rubrics_metrics.description: The Bellisario College is accredited by the Accrediting Council on Education in Journalism and Mass Communications, which conveys a commitment to the highest national standards for journalism and mass communication programs, and a focus on continuous improvement within the program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accreditation indicates program-level adherence to ACEJMC standards; the College undergoes periodic review as part of continuous improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: ACEJMC site visit cycle
rubrics_metrics.description: As part of the accreditation process, a team from the ACEJMC makes a site visit to the Bellisario College every six years to review all aspects of the program and interview faculty, staff and students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical implication: periodic external evaluation; a team of evaluators is scheduled to visit at the start of the 2025-26 academic year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upper-division hands-on class size limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Hands-on, upper-division classes are limited to 20 or fewer students — ensuring individual attention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete procedural standard tied to accreditation and student learning: small lab/studio class sizes intended to provide individual mentorship and practical experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faculty excellence in teaching, research, and service
rubrics_metrics.description: Faculty members blend strong academic and professional backgrounds and possess a commitment to excellence in teaching, research and service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: College emphasizes both academic credentials and professional experience; ACEJMC reviewers characterized faculty as “extremely productive and student oriented” providing “exceptional learning experiences.”

rubrics_metrics.name: Advising support for students
rubrics_metrics.description: A team of advisers in the Bellisario College provides information and insights for students who have questions ranging from scheduling to selecting a major.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational expectation: accessible advising resources to support student academic planning and success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program breadth and degree offerings
rubrics_metrics.description: The College’s four departments — Advertising/Public Relations; Film Production and Media Studies; Journalism; and Telecommunications — offer five undergraduate majors. Graduate students may pursue a master’s degree in media studies or a Ph.D. program in mass communications, with several distinct areas of emphasis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the educational scope and pathways available to prospective students; a factor in evaluating fit and program comprehensiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement on Diversity, Equity and Inclusive Excellence — overarching commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: The College proudly recognizes humanity is comprised of a wide array of people with storied experiences, complex backgrounds and unique identities. We believe that equitable access to media and communication technologies and media is essential and indicative of a healthy society and democracy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets the normative commitment that diversity, equity, and inclusion are central to the College’s mission and educational goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain an environment of respect and inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: We will maintain an environment of respect and inclusion for faculty, staff, students and members of the communities we serve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational DEI standard: expectation of respectful, inclusive daily interactions and institutional culture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foster expression of diverse points of view
rubrics_metrics.description: We will foster an environment that supports the expression of diverse points of view.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Normative standard balancing diversity with freedom of expression: create spaces where multiple perspectives are shared and considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Curricula and programs must reflect community diversity and challenge oppression
rubrics_metrics.description: We will provide curricula, programs and environments to students, faculty and staff that reflect the diversity of our communities, promote multicultural awareness and challenge oppression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Educational standard requiring curriculum design and programming that incorporate multicultural perspectives and address systemic inequities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure equitable access to facilities, programs, resources and services
rubrics_metrics.description: We will ensure equitable access to our facilities, programs, resources and services, and that our policies and practices reinforce our values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy and operational expectation to remove barriers and align institutional practices with stated values of equity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design hiring and promotion to attract and retain diverse talent
rubrics_metrics.description: We will design our hiring and promotion practices and review procedures to attract, retain and develop diverse talented faculty and staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Human-resources standard: proactive recruitment, retention, promotion practices to build and sustain diverse faculty and staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address and remedy disparities in representation and outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: We will address and remedy disparities in areas such as representation, retention, learning outcomes and graduation rates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accountability metric: monitor and intervene on measurable equity gaps across representation and student success indicators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledge land/historical responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: We acknowledge our responsibility and commitment to the College, to Penn State and to the wider community served by Pennsylvania’s sole land grant institution. Equally, we acknowledge the history and responsibility of our community as one that is located on the homelands of the Erie, Haudenosaunee, Lenape, Shawnee, Susquehannock and Wahzhazhe nations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutional acknowledgement of indigenous homelands and historical responsibilities as part of community commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Champion free speech while respecting responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: A vital part of our community is championing free speech and the rights and responsibilities that accompany it. We have an obligation to listen and to respect the opinions, beliefs and dignity of others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Normative standard: protect free expression while emphasizing respectful listening and dignity; implies balancing speech rights with community norms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support open dialogue, proactive transparency, and respect during hard conversations
rubrics_metrics.description: We support open dialogue, proactive transparency and respect for all, even during hard conversations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational expectation for how difficult topics should be handled: transparent processes, respectful engagement, and open discussion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community-based atmosphere and accountability
rubrics_metrics.description: We strive to provide a community-based atmosphere of caring, friendship and camaraderie. We pledge to be present and engaged with members of the Bellisario College community. We call for a commitment to honesty, integrity, equity and personal and collective accountability for our behavior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Behavioral and cultural standards for community engagement, mutual support, and accountability among members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to high-quality academic achievement and recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: In a spirit of collegiality, we are committed to the highest quality of academic achievement and to recognizing and celebrating the scholarly, social and personal achievements of our students, our co-workers and our alumni.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Academic standard emphasizing excellence and public recognition of accomplishments as part of the College’s culture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability Council commitments
rubrics_metrics.description: The Bellisario College Sustainability Council is committed to creating a culture of sustainability by promoting awareness of sustainability challenges, working collaboratively to discover knowledge to facilitate solutions, and advocating for best practices through teaching, research, operations and community partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational and educational standard: integrate sustainability into teaching, research, operations, and community engagement; promote awareness and collaborative problem-solving.
